content:
Overview

Buraidah is a city in Al Qassim with a population of 610,000. The capital of Al Qassim Province, a major agricultural center known for date production in central Saudi Arabia. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 325 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
